exposure: family history of hypertension in pregnancy
cohort: This study included 807 primigravida women who gave birth at a particular hospital between December 2020 and December 2021.
finding: The prevalence of HDP in primigravidae was 18.6%, with gestational hypertension accounting for 79.3% of cases, and it was significantly associated with increased maternal age, family history of HDP, BMI >30 kg/m2, hyperglycemia in pregnancy, IVF pregnancy, and PCOS.
